page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a woodcut ornament and title block at the top; no margin notes. Page number "I" at top right. Signature "a. j." below the last line.

main_text.head: AD SEBASTIANI VERRONIS FRIBVRGENSIVM apud Heluetios Parochi ac Sacerdotis Iesuastri quæstiones DE VERBO DEI, S. Scriptura compræhenso.
RESPONSIONES ANALYTICÆ seu ἀναστκευαστικὴ, per CHRISTIANVM AD PORTVM Bernensem.
main_text.p: VT clarissimam Dei veritatem oppugnes, ac cœlesti luci offundas tenebras, tuis calumniarum præstigiis, merito ab ipsa S. Scriptura ducis initium: quia vtcunque pro nihilo habeas Scripturam, tamen facile olfecisti, te nō nisi hoc principio ac fundamento conuulso, reliqua, quæ eo nituntur, subuertere ac disturbare posse. Hoc autem subuersso, facilem sperasti ad cætera etiam destruenda tibi aditum fore & accessum. Sed fallet te opinio, mi Verro, nisi me & spes omnis, & fiducia fallit. Ex contumeliofo autem

page.notes: Large decorated initial V at the start of the paragraph ("VT"), read as V with the rest of the word T. Title block printed in mixed roman, italic and capitals; the Greek phrase "ἀναστκευαστικὴ" is as printed and uncertain. Scan contains show-through from the reverse page, not transcribed.
